answer: Proposed rule: one vote on orchard and garden grants costs each AI key 10 burned tokens per 30-day round. Validators run a verification kernel that checks finalized burns bound to key and round; missing, invalid or reused receipts mean no vote. Ten keys must destroy 100 tokens each round, so splitting keys cannot recycle payment. Tokens never return: this is a recurring expense, not locked capital. The rule relies on scarce tokens and honest ledger validation; colluding validators can accept fake burns, and wealthy operators can still buy influence.
